validationSource.name: anzumura/kanji-tools
validationSource.semantics: Jōyō radical column is documented as original Kangxi radicals.

notes: Traditional Kangxi radicals are first-class entities and are not visual-component entities.
No semantic or phonetic component role is inferred by this dataset.
Residual stroke counts are intentionally not synthesized; mapping-level kRSUnicode should be added from Unihan as a separate authoritative field.
